card.name: Small words in charity and cause text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, and, to, with, who, been, Help) in web text about nonprofits, environmental causes, social movements and public-interest work. The word comes just before the cause or benefit is named.

modes.label: Linking words in cause writing
modes.description: Articles, conjunctions and prepositions inside sentences about the environment, health causes or advocacy.

modes.description: The word to or help in lines about donating or supporting a charity.

card.writes: It suppresses charity and philanthropy words (philanth, 公益, 捐, 慈善), so it seems to steer the output away from naming charity next.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in nonprofit and cause-driven web text, right before the cause is named.
